children: , the drugmaker behind major immunology, neuroscience and cancer medicines, added Iambic's AI platform to its small-molecule drug discovery work. Shares stays flat at around $265 at 11.34am ET time on Thursday.

Iambic's Enchant v3 platform analyzes several types of biomedical data and tests drug-design ideas in parallel. The multiyear deal includes an upfront payment, milestone payments and tiered royalties, but the companies did not disclose the amounts or how many drug programs are covered.

The picture puts AbbVie's price at $265.06 and GuruFocus' estimated fair value at $220.98, a 19.95% premium to that estimate. Broader predictions could help researchers screen weak candidates earlier, but they cannot prove a drug will work in people. The partnership's value will depend on the candidates it produces and their progress through clinical trials.

title: AbbVie Stays Flat as 6,000-Property AI Hunts Better Molecules
